title: juglans regia var. monophylla
intro: Juglans regia var. monophylla, commonly known as Chinese walnut, is a variety of walnut tree native to China. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Chinese walnut include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve cardiovascular health, and possess anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Chinese walnut include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects.
